scored_result.pipeline: merge_sft_adapter_16bit.py -> run_eval.py --live-vllm (SelfAware response_confidence, full n=3369) -> calibration_gap_report.py Analysis A -> amendment_r_falsifier_check.py. All 3 arms scored in one detached unsloth container (eh-amendment-r-score), exit 0.
scored_result.train_loss_note: A0 is pure LM (head off); directly interpretable. A1/A2 train_loss is COMBINED LM+aux and not comparable.
scored_result.mechanism: Emitted stated-confidence is a near-deterministic function of the answer/abstain ACTION (conf|answered ~0.88-0.95, conf|refused ~0.00) in all arms, not an appropriateness estimate. Aux co-training shifted the policy toward answering more (refusals A0 2256 > A1 1912 > A2 1394), raising confident-wrong answers and LOWERING appropriateness-AUROC. The head fit its target internally (A1 combined loss 4.557 < A2 5.530) but that did NOT propagate to the emitted channel: internal->emitted dissociation persists. Non-locked footnote: auroc_emitted_correct_vs_wrong|answered_known flips order and is >chance (A0 0.581 < A1 0.607 < A2 0.651), but that is not the gate.
